title: R24 TABLESTYLE DWG writer for AC1024 and AC1027

scope.specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.101.2-.4
scope.fields: R24 TABLESTYLE prefix, table cell style, three cell styles, and modeled text-style/linetype hard-pointer handles
exclusions: DXF schema or native consumer qualification

implementation.behavior: The writer admits the modeled three-style R24 profile for AC1024/AC1027, writes the body and handle streams, and refuses malformed style counts or unsupported CMC forms. The typed local reader verifies generated output and handle roles.

validation.coverage: Generated AC1024 and AC1027 write/readback, expected body fields and hard-pointer text-style/linetype references, malformed profile refusal, unsupported CMC refusal, and follow-up successful writes are checked. Controls are generated locally; no drawing fixture is committed.

evidenceLimit: Encoder/parser consistency is not independent physical DWG interoperability or consumer semantic evidence.
